_comment: Offline genetic-tuning config (M5-4, HW6 salvage adapted; ADR-0002-logged). Per-repo: each repo evolves ITS role brain's weight vector against a fixed reference opponent over a fresh scenario-seed suite (never the DoD seeds - no gate overfitting). This copy evolves ThiefBrain's continuous weights vs ref-police (barrier coin-flip at the arena's attributed 0.15). Structural knobs (top_k, caps, deception timing - invisible to referee-mode fitness) stay out of the box. The 'smoke' block drives the keyless CI determinism/elitism test; the 'run' block drives the committed offline evolution (scripts/ga_run.py). Tuned weights never deploy to the sparring host (CLAUDE.md s9).
